intervention_names: Device: continuous glucose monitor based insulin bolus calculator
arm_groups.label: CGM insulin bolus calculator arm

brief_summary: This study examines the safety of an app-based insulin bolus calculator that utilizes glucose values from a continuous glucose monitor
brief_title: A Continuous Glucose Monitor Based Insulin Bolus Calculator

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* type 1 diabetes
* type 2 diabetes
* using Dexcom G6 CGM system
* injecting bolus insulin

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy,
* insulin pump use

interventions.name: continuous glucose monitor based insulin bolus calculator

official_title: Safety of a Real-time Continuous Glucose Monitor-based Insulin Bolus Calculator: The "CGM-IBC" Study
